riskRegister.description: Raspberry Pi may struggle with multiple simultaneous HLS streams at 720p.
riskRegister.impact: Could degrade operator dashboard responsiveness and video quality.
riskRegister.mitigation: Optimize ffmpeg pipelines, limit concurrent streams, allow quality downgrade to MJPEG.

riskRegister.description: Competitors offer extensive CRM and marketing features that MVP will not include.
riskRegister.impact: May limit adoption if differentiators are unclear.
riskRegister.mitigation: Emphasize offline reliability and mobile event tooling in messaging; collect pilot testimonials.

riskRegister.description: Limited availability of USB AC600M adapters could delay deployments.
riskRegister.impact: Creates bottleneck for testing and pilot rollout.
riskRegister.mitigation: Identify alternate supported adapters and pre-order critical hardware.

riskRegister.description: Mobile operations requirements may expand scope beyond MVP timeline.
riskRegister.impact: Could delay pilot or reduce feature completeness.
riskRegister.mitigation: Prioritize must-have mobile features and defer advanced analytics post-launch.

riskRegister.description: Self-signed HTTPS certificates may be rejected by operator devices without manual trust installation.
riskRegister.impact: Delays setup and reduces confidence during pilot demos.
riskRegister.mitigation: Provide cert-export CLI, documented trust steps, and optional USB bundle for onboarding.
